Name: Expanded Storage
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
This mod allows Content Pack Creators to add custom storage to the game. Expand Requirements to see Content Packs supported by this mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Expanded Storage is safe to add/remove at any time. Custom chests added by Expanded Storage will revert to vanilla chests if Expanded Storage is removed from your game. It should work with any other mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7FhH4Ge.png[/img]
Expanded Storage chests are loaded using [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/ExpandedStorage/blob/main/docs/content-patcher.md]Content Patcher[/url] and can be customized with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url].
Check out the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807]6480's Storage Variety[/url] for an example which uses most of Expanded Storage's features.

Feel free to visit me on my [url=https://lxnq.to/discord]Discord server[/url] for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You can also request help from me on the Stardew Valley discord in [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/1272025932932055121]#modded-tech-support[/url]﻿ (ping me @LeFauxMatt).
